allowlistNote: The generated bundle is multi-megabyte; only the JSON-RPC message envelope and the ServerRequest unions (the security-critical inbound frames: approvals, user input, elicitation, dynamic tool calls) are pinned. Server notifications are intentionally not schema-validated: unknown or drifted notifications must pass through preserved as provider events, never dropped and never fail-closed. Client requests are outbound and typed at the call site.
